name: Vampire - Spider Climb - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a feature

results.text: The vampire's crimson eyes lock onto the ceiling, claws flexing with predatory precision before ascent begins.
A faint hiss echoes as the undead lord prepares to defy gravity once more, shadows writhing beneath him.
With a bone-chilling whisper, the vampire turns his gaze upward, sensing the cold embrace of stone awaiting.
The air grows thick with anticipation as the monstrous figure coils, ready to scale the impossible heights.
A predatory grin spreads across the pale face as claws find purchase on the slick, vertical surface.
